script_text: Stop! Aries, the cosmos just flipped a switch inside your soul and it demands your full attention right now. Mars, your ruling fire planet, is charging directly through your 1st House of Self in a powerful conjunction with the Sun, igniting raw ambition and a blaze of unstoppable personal drive. At the same time, Saturn is forming a tense square from fixed Aquarius deep into your 11th House of Friendships and Social Circles, exposing which alliances truly deserve your loyalty. Meanwhile, Venus is drifting through your 5th House of Romance, opening the door for a thrilling chance encounter that catches you completely off guard. The Sun's daily transit across your 6th House of Health and Daily Work points to a major breakthrough on a long-running project or an unexpected recognition from your boss. Don't let Mars's fire push you into impulsive financial commitments today. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
